title: The text discusses the 1998 Nigerian presidential election and the role of Chief Moshood Abiola, who was a presidential aspirant. Former President Olusegun Obasanjo revealed that Abiola was a "rallying point" for the election, but he exited the country at a time when he was needed most. Obasanjo also discussed the annulment of the election and allegations that he was sponsored by General Ibrahim Babangida. Additionally, he addressed calls for the restructuring of the federal government and the misuse of institutions. Finally, he promised to correct lopsidedness in the implementation of federalism.
